newsitem.title: JAPAN: Naphtha prices hit five-year high in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Naphtha prices hit five-year high in Tokyo.

text.p: Naphtha prices rose to a five-year high in Tokyo afternoon trade on Thursday due to an overnight rally in crude prices as well as vigorous regional demand for physical cargoes, traders said.
"I think it's partly crudes, partly the fact that the physical market here still looks very strong (that pushed up naphtha levels)," one trader said.
First-half January open-spec naphtha was assessed at $230.00/$232.00, topping the previous high of $223.50/$225.00 hit in late Wednesday trade.
A year ago, first-half January cargoes were traded at around $161.00/$162.00.
